jornada-ia.title: From chat to agent: 4 sequences to really get into AI
jornada-ia.h1: From chat to agent, in four steps
jornada-ia.lead: Move beyond copy and paste and create agents that work for you: on your computer, in a task queue, and on your social media.
jornada-ia.description: Overview of the From chat to agent series: why chat hits a wall, the 4 sequences (OSWork, Jarvis, queues, and automated social media), the right order, and where to start today. Open and free.
jornada-ia.resumo: Most people stop at chat: ask, copy, paste, and ask again. This series shows the whole path to creating agents that work on their own, in four sequences. First the terminal and folders (OSWork), then your own assistant on Telegram (INTELECTO), then a task queue that runs while you sleep (inemaccbot), and finally automated social media. Each sequence includes a course, an open project, a video, and exercises with a clear completion criterion.

sections.h2: Chat hits a wall. The system keeps going.
sections.sub: In chat, you're the driver the whole time. When you close the window, the work stops.

left: You ask, copy, paste, and adjust.
The AI can't see your files.
It forgets what you explained yesterday.
Close the window and the work stops.
right: You give it the task and check the result.
It reads and writes files in your folder.
It reads the project rules every time it starts.
It keeps working while you do something else.

blocks.text: The shift isn't about learning a new model. It's about changing where you work: from chat to the system.

sections.h2: The whole path, one step at a time
sections.sub: Each step builds on the previous one. Click a sequence to see its page.
There is no "render while you sleep" if the system doesn't run correctly.

blocks.text: If you skip sequence 1, you'll get stuck on the other three. Folders, the terminal, and simple commands are the foundation for everything that follows: Jarvis needs a configuration file and a key stored in the right place, the queue needs an organized project, and the automated channel needs a queue and an approval gate.

seq1-oswork.title: Sequence 1 — From chat to the terminal: OSWork
seq1-oswork.lead: With a handful of commands, you can leave chat behind and get Claude Code or Codex working on your files.
seq1-oswork.description: Sequence 1 of the From chat to agent series: the terminal, folders, AGENTS.md, your first task for the agent, Git, and secrets kept out of text. Includes a video, exercises, and the OSWork course, open and free.
seq1-oswork.resumo: OSWork is the step that separates people who use AI from people who create with it. You'll learn six terminal commands, organize your work in folders with markdown text files, and write an AGENTS.md with the project rules. Then you start the agent inside the folder, give it a task, and check the result. Finally, you add a safety net: Git to undo mistakes and a secrets file for your keys.

sections.h2: In chat, you become the messenger
sections.sub: Chat AI can't see your files and forgets what you explained yesterday.

blocks.text: Every answer has to be copied and pasted into the right place. You spend the day carrying text from the window to your work and back. OSWork shows the path through three windows, Chat, Work, and Desktop, and then the terminal, where the agent lives.

sections.h2: The terminal is just another window
sections.sub: You type a command and it responds. This isn't programming: it's moving through your folders without a mouse.

blocks.text: # Mac and Linux: your agent's first folder mkdir -p projetos/meu-primeiro-agente cd projetos/meu-primeiro-agente pwd ls

sections.h2: One folder per project, one AGENTS.md
sections.sub: Folders are the key. Inside each one, you'll find markdown text files.

blocks.text: The AGENTS.md contains the project rules: who you are, what the agent can do, and what it can't. The agent reads this file every time it starts. It's like handing a new employee the manual.

# Who I am
Ana, an accountant who works with small businesses.

# Rules for this project
- Write in Portuguese, using short sentences.
- Don't delete files without asking.
- Before you finish, say what changed and how I can check it.

# What's here
- index.html: my page

sections.h2: You give the task, the agent does it
sections.sub: Go into the project folder and start Claude Code (claude) or Codex (codex).

blocks.text: cd projetos/meu-primeiro-agente claude # or: codex
Read AGENTS.md. Create an index.html with a simple page about me, using what's in it.

The files appear in the folder. Open the page in your browser, ask for a correction, and check it again. You didn't program anything: you gave the task, checked the result, and made a decision. That's management.

sections.h2: The safety net: Git, secrets, and VPS
sections.sub: Mistakes are cheap when you can roll them back.

items.title: Git saves every version
items.text: Make a commit before each big change. If the agent makes a mistake, git restore brings the file back.

items.title: Keep secrets out of text
items.text: Keys and passwords go in a .env file, listed in .gitignore. Never put them in the code.

items.title: Telegram and VPS
items.text: At the end of the journey, Telegram becomes the interface and a VPS keeps the agent running while your computer is off.

blocks.text: git init git add . git commit -m "primeira versão" # don't like the agent's change? git restore index.html

seq2-jarvis.card_text: Your own assistant on Telegram, with memory and a personality you choose.
seq2-jarvis.title: Sequence 2 — Create your Jarvis with INTELECTO
seq2-jarvis.lead: A personal assistant that talks with you on Telegram, remembers your conversations, and has the personality you choose.
seq2-jarvis.description: Sequence 2 of the From chat to agent series: INTELECTO, a personal Python assistant that chats on Telegram, with memory and a cloud model (OpenRouter) or local model (Ollama). Setup, exercises, and course, open and free.
seq2-jarvis.resumo: INTELECTO is a personal assistant written from scratch in Python, kept small on purpose so you can read, understand, and change it. It receives your messages on Telegram, thinks in an agent loop, searches memory, uses tools, and replies with a cloud model (OpenRouter) or one on your computer (Ollama). Setup takes one command and a six-step configuration assistant. It comes after OSWork because it uses the terminal, folders, and a key stored in the right place.

sections.sub: No heavy framework, no Docker, no web dashboard.

items.title: About 3,000 lines
items.text: Python code you can read in an afternoon. You'll understand what it does.

items.title: 7 dependencies
items.text: Fewer pieces to install and almost nothing to break.

items.title: Truly yours
items.text: It runs on your computer. You no longer have to open a website to chat.

sections.sub: It's the same design as big assistants, only it's yours.

left: Pay as you go, with your own key.
Doesn't depend on your computer's power.
right: Runs on your machine, with no cost per message.
Your data stays on your computer.
Needs memory and preferably a graphics card.

sections.sub: start.sh sets up the environment and opens the configuration assistant.

git clone https://github.com/inematds/intelecto.git
cd intelecto
./start.sh

blocks.text: The token and keys stay only in the configuration file, never in text that goes into Git. That's the rule you learned in sequence 1.

sections.sub: Memory and personality are what make it your Jarvis.

blocks.text: It remembers what you talked about, saves what matters, and speaks the way you chose. Tell it on Monday that you close the sales report every week; on Tuesday, in a new conversation, ask what you do on Mondays. It's not a website that forgets everything when you close the tab.

seq3-filas.title: Sequence 3 — Agent queues: inemaccbot works while you sleep
seq3-filas.h1: Ten tasks and go to sleep
seq3-filas.lead: A task queue for your agents, with recovery if something stops and a gate where work waits for your approval.
seq3-filas.description: Sequence 3 of the From chat to agent series: why one agent isn't enough, the durable inemaccbot queue, skills that run in the queue, and the human approval gate. Includes a video, a home-built queue, and exercises, open and free.
seq3-filas.resumo: An agent in the terminal does one thing at a time and only while you're watching. A queue solves that: each request becomes a saved task, picked up one at a time and resumed if the machine goes down. inemaccbot is a Telegram bot with this durable queue, running skills such as transcription, dubbing, explainer videos, courses, and reels. In multi-stage workflows, a human gate makes the bot stop and wait for your approval. This is where you go from doing the work to managing it.

sections.h2: One agent on its own gets lost
sections.sub: It does one thing at a time, and only while you're watching.

items.title: It stops, work is lost
items.text: If the internet goes down or the machine restarts, the work in progress disappears.

items.title: Ten requests collide
items.text: Simultaneous requests compete for the same folder and the same agent.

items.title: You stuck at the screen
items.text: Without a queue, someone has to keep sending the next request.

sections.sub: Each request becomes a task saved in a SQLite database.

items: Done or back in the queue

blocks.text: While it runs, the task sends a heartbeat. If the signal stops because the machine went down or the process froze, the task goes back in the queue and resumes. Before installing the bot, you can see the same idea in 30 lines with this repository's home-built queue:

mkdir -p fila/entrada echo "Resuma em 5 linhas o que é uma fila de tarefas." > fila/entrada/01.md echo "Liste 3 riscos de deixar um agente rodando sozinho." > fila/entrada/02.md ./ferramentas/fila-caseira.sh fila # replies in fila/feito/

sections.sub: You send the request on Telegram. The default engine is Claude Code, with Codex or OpenCode as alternatives.
Multi-stage workflows, with the state saved at each stage.

items.title: The bot writes the copy
items.text: The workflow's first stage, without spending anything expensive.

items.title: Then it stops at the gate
items.text: You read it, make any needed changes, and approve or reject it.

items.title: Only then does it continue
items.text: Avatar, download, and video run after you say okay.

blocks.text: You define the tasks, gates, and rules. The agents run through the queue, and you decide at the points that matter. From doing the work to managing it.

seq4-redes.card_title: The viral channel for your niche
seq4-redes.card_text: r7e, promoavatar, and xviral: finviral, saudeviral, and advviral publishing with sources on screen.
seq4-redes.title: Sequence 4 — Automated social media: r7e, promoavatar, and your niche's viral channel
seq4-redes.lead: A channel that posts on its own every day about your niche, with numbers, sources, and your face.
seq4-redes.description: Sequence 4 of the From chat to agent series: the 7-stage reel (r7e), promoavatar, and xviral channels (finviral, saudeviral, advviral) that post on their own with sources on screen. How to create a viral channel for your niche. Open and free.
seq4-redes.resumo: The final sequence brings it all together to automate social media. r7e builds a reel in seven trigger stages, with one image per stage, an avatar speaking, and quality gates. promoavatar makes avatar promo videos for twelve audiences, stopping for your approval. xviral (finviral, saudeviral, and advviral) watches the biggest creators in the niche, pulls out numbers and sources, checks each segment, and publishes on its own. The engine is the same; only the topic changes.

sections.sub: You write the idea; the system builds a reel with seven triggers in sequence.

blocks.text: The system generates one image per stage, the avatar speaks, the caption highlights the right word, and the reel passes through quality gates before publishing. It ends by asking for a comment with one word, which starts a conversation with whoever watched.

sections.sub: A workflow inside inemaccbot that makes avatar promo videos for twelve different audiences.

items.title: It continues
items.text: Avatar, download, and reel, without you at the screen.

blocks.text: promoavatar3 goes further: three videos per audience, one for reach, one for authority, and one promotional.

sections.sub: Finance, health, and law, with the source on screen.

items: Watches the biggest creators in the niche
Pulls out numbers, facts, and controversies

blocks.text: The video comes with animated numbers, the source written on screen, and an avatar commenting. finviral runs every day overnight, and on weekends it also makes a long video explaining the week. A slow news day doesn't become a video, and if anything fails, you get an alert on Telegram.

sections.sub: Change the reference channels and the rules for your niche.

blocks.text: This only works on top of the three previous sequences. Without a queue and a gate, automating social media means posting mistakes faster.
